moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio rotate-reveal, written here): Card hinged on its left edge opens like a door: rotationY −88° → 0 in 720 ms power2.out, perspective 360 px; opacity follows the angle, 0.2 → 1. Site exit: closes back to −88° in 450 ms power2.in. (The DOM fallback adds a 5° overshoot at 84 %.) Params: duration (0.72 s) · from (−88°) · perspective (360 px) · origin (mép trái).
